verdict.rationale: Tilled's payouts docs mention a per-merchant "payout speed" viewable in the Dashboard, which suggests per-seller payout timing exists. The pack never says this speed is configurable or what the options are. Closing a batch via API lets a store settle transactions at end of shift, which touches on settlement timing but is not a payout schedule. Missing for 10: documented daily/weekly/monthly schedule options, manual payouts, instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, evidence that ops can set the schedule per seller, and independent corroboration.
